After reversal every item is a positively-keyed indicator of one factor; per-item means span only 3.03-3.33 at T0 (BP1=3.33, BP5=3.03) with no published per-item statistics, no differing response ranges (all 9 items 1-5, n=1128 each) and no subscale structure to test.
